steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's dangerous to lose focus on the battlefield.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just... am having trouble understanding...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reunion has bunkered down inside an abandoned mine.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That woman, W, also fled inside.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can give you some space if you need time alone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, the L.G.D. has no time to waste.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, gather the others.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Misha...)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have one concern.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Concern?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W is a master of explosives.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's highly likely that she has deployed traps on the battlefield.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm worried that... we'd sustain heavy casualties from a direct confrontation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My suggestion is for Rhodes Island to sneak into the mine while your forces set up an encirclement.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'll flush out the Reunion forces, and you can arrest them immediately...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And those who refuse to surrender, we'll handle our way.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How confident do you feel about facing that woman?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not sure...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...But we can bear that risk.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've fought her more than once before. At least we have some understanding of her fighting style.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are some risks... that the L.G.D. can't afford to shoulder.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We can't afford to lose sight of the mission objective either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: PC94172, take our forces and surround the mines!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, pick out a few troops to take with you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll each take a squad and move in with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, you and Rhodes Island will split off and pincer them. Destroy their base of operations, and rout their defenses.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll take care of the firebases.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: For Lungmen's sake, we have to...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...bring Misha back.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll gather our operators.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, there's a small group of Reunion forces heading out along the edge of the mines.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're moving pretty quickly, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll head out first, otherwise we might lose them.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hurry. Don't let them get away.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, Madam Hoshiguma, please wait a moment.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When they ambushed us earlier, they were hiding some casters among their forces.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'd recommend taking two of our operators, Franka and Liskarm, with your squad.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They have a lot of experience fighting casters.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: All right, let's do this, shall we?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What about you, Amiya?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told us to...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is backing me up, so I'll be fine.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sounds like a plan.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I can't stress this enough, but don't be too stubborn. Back off if the situation gets too rough.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't have much time left.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This isn't like Chernobog... This time, it's our turn to stop Reunion!
